craft_notes: Sthāyin: waning mirror. Rows: fill, hinge, fruit. Read aloud: return tide.

lines: Then in-breath the knowing-sun brims digit by digit the in-breath moon
till the fifteenth wink is full — then hinge and grip as before —
but this-world-fruiting: so the month's rise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ praviśati prāṇe cidarka ekaikayā kalayā apānacandram āpūrayati yāvat pañcadaśī tuṭiḥ pūrṇimā tadanantaraṃ pakṣasaṃdhiḥ grahaṇaṃ ca iti prāgvat etat tu aihikaphalapradam iti māsodayaḥ
